brand.description: Only these brands, by name, comma-separated (e.g. Anker,Belkin).

category.description: Amazon search category alias (e.g. electronics) or numeric browse node ID (e.g. 172541).

country.description: Amazon marketplace as an ISO country code. GB is amazon.co.uk. Default US.

filters.description: Comma-separated values from a previous response's refinements (Prime, 4 stars and up, condition, deal type). They differ by marketplace.

seller_id.description: Only products sold by this third-party seller.
